paper_style.palette_strategy: Figure 1 uses pale blue/pink model-role fills; Figure 2 uses the Sane TikZ pastel module palette plus a compact final-layer flow; Figures 3–4 use saturated categorical series colors; Figure 5 uses blue point estimates and a pale-blue band; Figure 6 uses blue measured points versus a gray extrapolation; Figures 7, 9, 11 and both tables are grayscale. Color is mostly local to each object and has no global token across all figures. The PDF itself is vector; Figure 2 left-panel RGB values are source-exact from the credited Sane TikZ example, while other colors are rendered estimates.

The public Sane TikZ repository supplies only the credited Transformer left-panel builder for Figure 2, not the complete paper visuals or tables.
paper_style.style_consistency: The paper uses a restrained serif/math visual language, thin black outlines, centered page-width diagrams, compact line charts, and booktabs tables. Figure 2, 8, and 10 share a flow-diagram vocabulary; Figures 3–6 share axes and saturated line colors. Readability weakens where labels are dense, gray numeric residue appears (Figures 2 and 4), y axes are omitted (Figure 11), or long extrapolation is shown without uncertainty (Figure 6).

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Language model logits are subject to constraints that force them to lie on a high-dimensional ellipse. This constitutes a signature because we can identify which model generated an output by checking which ellipse it lies on. Among other unique properties, we show that ellipse signatures are forgery-resistant because it is computationally hard in practice to generate signed logits without access to the model parameters.

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: A typical language model’s final layers consist of normalization followed by a linear (or affine) transformation. Normalization has the effect of mapping the representations onto the surface of a sphere, while the linear layer stretches and rotates this sphere, resulting in an ellipse. Transformer diagram credit Vaswani et al. (2017); Negrinho (2020).

figures.label: Figure 7
figures.module: §4 ellipse signatures as message authentication codes

caption.text: Figure 7: A cryptographic message authentication system (left) uses a shared secret key to validate messages. The message author, Alice, signs the message by generating a tag from the message and a secret key. After receiving the message and tag, Bob verifies the message by generating another tag with his copy of the key. If the received and generated tags match, the message is authentic. In our proposed verification system (right), the ellipse functions as a secret key, and logprobs take the role of messages. The tag is encoded in the position of the logprobs in R^v, and can be verified by checking that they lie on the secret ellipse.

caption.text: Figure 8: An overview of the intermediate representations in both traditional (gray) and our own (yellow) parameterization of the final LM layers. color.semantic_mapping: 黑色 histogram bars/边框与浅灰 Plot area inset；panel title、zoom connector 和刻度提供冗余。

encodings.x: normalized hidden-state L2 norm，左图含 0–1 全范围 inset，主图/右图为窄窗口
encodings.y: histogram count/密度轴（未显示 y tick/title）
encodings.line: 柱高表示分布频数/密度
encodings.facet: GPT NeoX 1M 与 Llama 3 8B 两 panel；左 panel 另有 Plot area inset

figures.data_and_statistics: 直方图比较 ε=1×10^-5 下 normalized hidden-state norms；模型 hidden sizes 为 64 与 4096。左 panel 用 0–1 inset 和 0.988–1 zoom，右 panel 放大到约 0.999985–1。未给 bin width、样本数、y 轴单位或均值/离散量。
figures.evidence_relation: Appendix G 的 smoothing robustness 诊断，支撑大模型 norms 更靠近 1、忽略 ε 时 scaling 轻微低估；与 Figure 4 的 smoothing 参数误差和 Appendix F 的 solver sanity check 相连。
design_strengths: 全范围 inset 与窄区间主窗口兼顾支持范围和峰形。
两个模型并置后，大模型分布更紧的方向性易读。
黑色柱在灰度复制中稳定。
design_weaknesses: y 轴无标度，分布高度无法定量比较。
两个 panel 使用不同 x 窗口，直接比较需先读刻度。
binning、样本量和 `Plot area` 的内部性质未交代。
figures.reusable_pattern: 对接近边界的分布使用全范围 inset + 局部 zoom，并在 caption 补充 binning、样本量和 y 轴定义。

The number of samples required grows quadratically with the hidden size of the model, and the price grows cubically.

tables.uncertainty: 没有统计不确定性；脚注 a/b/c 将 hidden size 或 cost 标成 confirmed、estimated upper limit、hypothetical。pythia-70m 的 Ellipse ($) 单元格为空。
tables.data_and_statistics: 模型行含 hidden size d、vocab size、Samples for Ellipsoid 和 Ellipse ($)。样本数为椭圆参数辨识的解析/估算需求，美元基于 2025-09-16 OpenAI inference pricing；整数用千位逗号，成本为美元整数。
tables.evidence_relation: 将 Eq. (2) 的 quadratic sample lower bound、API token-prefix cost 与 cubic price argument 放在一张决策表，与 Figure 5 的 sample effect、Figure 6 的 fitting-time extrapolation 共同支撑 production-scale extraction barrier。
design_strengths: hidden/vocab/sample/cost 四个量按模型行对齐，增长关系可直接比较。
脚注区分 confirmed、estimated 和 hypothetical 状态。
booktabs 和等宽模型名提高扫描性。
design_weaknesses: 表头 `Samples for Ellipsoid` 与正文 ellipse 术语不一致。
pythia 成本空缺原因没有写在表头或 caption。
pythia 的 131,327 与 Eq. (2) 直接算出的 131,840 相差 513，论文未解释。
定价日期和 gpt-4-turbo 假设必须结合脚注读取。
tables.reusable_pattern: 把抽象维度增长转换为样本数、美元和模型行，并用脚注明确 observed/estimated/hypothetical 状态。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 establishes ellipse-as-signature; Figure 2 grounds it in normalization→sphere→linear→ellipse; Figure 3 supplies cross-model diagonal identification; Figures 4–5 test smoothing and sample budget; Table 1/Figure 6 translate recovery into samples, dollars and solver years; Figure 7 maps the ellipse to a MAC key/message/tag protocol; Table 2 and Figures 8–11 provide method comparison, recoverable parameterization, layer-norm dimension and smoothing boundary.
cross_object_system.caption_system: Main captions are complete sentences and usually state setup, encoding and directional finding. Figure 2 includes visual credit; Figure 3 defines shaded standard errors; Figure 4 defines angle range; Figure 6 names the polynomial degree and measured color; Figure 7 explains both protocol sides. Appendix captions are shorter and structural. Figure 4 leaves x-index semantics implicit and Figure 11 leaves histogram y-axis/bin definitions implicit.
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Both tables use one-level black-and-white booktabs headers. Table 1 uses model rows and size/sample/cost columns; Table 2 uses method rows and four categorical property columns. Footnotes and the Table 2 `-` label carry evidential status; no cross-table color token is used.
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figures 2/8/9/10 plus Algorithms 1–2 are method/theory interfaces; Figure 3 is the main comparison; Figures 4–5 and 11 are smoothing/sample robustness diagnostics; Table 1 and Figure 6 are cost/efficiency evidence; Figure 7 is the protocol application. The sequence follows the paper’s causal chain from geometry to identification, recovery, cost and verification.
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: The main text retains the ellipse geometry, cross-model distance, fitting-error curves, sample-cost table, runtime extrapolation and MAC proposal. Appendix A–H supplies centered-logit equivalence, method comparison, reparameterization/proof, layer-norm recovery, solver implementation, smoothing histogram and logit-transformation limits. Figures 8–10 reuse Figure 2 vocabulary, while Figure 11 diagnoses the error source in Figure 4.
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: TeX Gyre Termes X and NewTX math fonts dominate PDF text and diagrams; roman/italic math, monospace model names and bold section/caption labels are local variants. Figure labels and captions remain readable, while dense arrow labels in Figures 2, 8 and 10 use the smallest type.
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Color is semantically local: pastel role fills in diagrams, saturated series in Figures 3–4, blue estimate/band in Figure 5, blue-vs-gray measurement/fit in Figure 6, and grayscale protocol/geometry/histogram/table objects. There is no cross-object palette contract; Figures 1–4 are weaker under grayscale than Figures 7, 9 and 11.

most_reusable_patterns: Figure 1 的约束几何与同源/异源点对照，适合在引言建立可检查的 signature 判据。
Figure 2、8、10 的双路径流程把公式拆成表示、算子、空间和可恢复参数。
Figure 3 的 source×target 矩阵和 Figure 5 的预算—误差曲线把主张变成结构性视觉模式。
Figure 6 的实测 inset/外推主图分离 measured 与 extrapolated，Table 1 再将复杂度换成成本单位。
highest_value_objects: Figure 3：跨模型身份判别的主证据。
Table 1 与 Figure 6：样本、美元和 solver time 的可决策化证据。
failure_patterns: Figure 2 和 Figure 4 有未解释的灰色序号样残留。
Figure 3–5 的颜色/误差带在灰度和缩小后不稳定。
Figure 6 的 degree-6 长程外推没有 uncertainty 或阶数敏感性。
Table 1 的 pythia 样本数与 Eq. (2) 算术存在未解释差异；Figure 11 缺少 y 轴、bin 和样本说明；Figure 8/10 使用 `Cannonical` 拼写。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文按“几何直觉→跨模型对角识别→拟合/成本压力→MAC 协议→附录参数化边界”推进，使 ellipse signature 从概念判据落到可验证但生产规模难恢复的证据链。
